parole.significato: A soup or stew made of hominy, cornmeal and bits of meat.
A small burrowing rodent native to North and Central America, especially in the family Geomyidae (pocket gophers).
parole.testo: Perhaps an adaptation of Cajun French gaufre (literally “honeycomb, waffle”), based on the analogy of holes in the ground to the indentations in a honeycomb or a waffle (doublet of waffle). Alternatively, from Muskogean.
